stem.text: The diagram shows the Boltzmann distribution of energies for a reactant gas. For a particular reaction, the activation energy is $X$.

stem.alt: Boltzmann distribution graph: number of particles with energy E against energy E. Curve starts at the origin, rises to a peak, then falls away. Energy X is marked on the energy axis by a dashed line.

stem.text: Which change to the diagram occurs if an effective catalyst is added at the same temperature?

A.text: More particles will possess higher values of $E$.

B.text: The peak will move to the left.

C.text: The peak will move to the right.

D.text: The value of the activation energy decreases.
